_comment: Seven criteria, each scored 0 (fail), 1 (partial) or 2 (pass) against written anchors, multiplied by its weight. Criterion order is the tie-break order. Maximum 24.

anchors: an adjacent role can be extended
an existing role does it with values changes only
fixes a side-effect of the branch
cluster-wide: webhook, CRD, global RBAC, node
several namespaces or a shared controller
reversible, but no meaningful dry run
documented rollback and a meaningful dry run
